name: T1_divisibility_lattice

provenance.source: Card Model Research Handover (2026-10-22), sections 8, 11 and the theorems the formal core needs

statement: gcd and lcm are the meet and join of divisibility on exponent vectors over any basis, the lattice is distributive, divisibility is having a cofactor, gcd times lcm is the product, and multiplication cancels.
